title: Lithe young man, clad in mourning, a wide hat
html_source:
Stephen.

Stephen has come north on the Dalkey tram as far as Haddington Road where, instead of going on into Dublin, he apparently changes to the Sandymount tram and travels east toward Irishtown, where the Gouldings live; but instead of calling on them he walks south and east toward Leahy’s Terrace and Sandymount Strand, where he spends the Proteus episode.
